stem: The random variable $X$ has the distribution $\text{B}(400, 0.01)$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: State an appropriate approximating distribution for $X$, giving the values of any parameters. Justify your choice of approximating distribution.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Use your approximating distribution to find $\text{P}(2 \leqslant X \leqslant 5)$.
